content: ULP unit in last place is the standard metric for FP rounding-error tolerance. Direct3D11/GPU vendors guarantee only 0.5-2 ULP correctness for basic ops, more for transcendentals sin/cos/exp use vendor-specific polynomial approximations, so cross-vendor ULP drift on those ops is much larger than basic add/mul. Bruce Dawson Random ASCII and bitbashing.io are canonical references warning against naive epsilon comparison; ULP-distance comparison is recommended but tolerance must be picked per-operation, not globally.
